newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAFRICA BLACK ELECTRICITY FIRM TO BE LAUNCHED THURSDAY.
newsitem.headline: SAFRICA BLACK ELECTRICITY FIRM TO BE LAUNCHED THURSDAY.

text.p: South Africa's largest black-owned electricity networking, engineering and construction company, will officially be launched on Thursday, a company spokesman said on Wednesday.
The firm, Sizabantu Electrical Ltd, has the potential to produce annual turnover of around 100 million rand, the firm said in a statement.
Known as ERE Holdings before its acquisition by Malesela Holdings Ltd, it has been in operation for 28 years.

"This is the only black-owned company concentrating on infrastructural development, so it has a strong commitment to improving the quality of life for all South Africans," chairman Malesela Motlatla said.
He said the company would soon expand into transmission and power generation through a planned strategic partnership with a multinational company.
